note: AS-IS BASELINE (captured at plan ①, before any code change) of exactly what this change touches: renderCard's two-branch body. The focused branch builds a COLOURLESS body because cardFocused paints one fg/bg fill over the whole card, and a lipgloss block fill tears at every inner ESC[0m reset (measured with the pinned lipgloss v1.1.1-0.20250404203927 at ANSI256) - so the plain branch exists to hide the per-segment holes. The gate stripe REPLACES the whole border set here. Same shape in plans_tab.go renderPlanCard, and in the changelog/config rows via changelogFocusStyle.
